name: spec-preparation
title: Implementation-ready specification preparation
description: Platform-neutral workflow for SPEC requests. Produces a traceable implementation-ready specification and does not modify application code.

stages.title: Intake and repository map
stages.prompt: Normalize the request, inspect repository structure and conventions, identify affected modules/symbols/configuration, and gather authoritative local or external evidence. Separate verified facts, assumptions, and open questions; do not edit code or specification files.

stages.title: Requirements and edge cases
stages.prompt: Convert the intake into testable functional requirements, non-goals, acceptance criteria, invariants, error behavior, lifecycle/state transitions, security/privacy constraints, compatibility constraints, and edge cases. Trace every requirement to evidence or mark it as a decision needed.

stages.title: Options and decision log
stages.prompt: Compare materially different implementation options against repository conventions, complexity, risk, migration cost, operability, testability, and reversibility. Recommend one conservative option and record rejected alternatives, rationale, assumptions, and unresolved decisions.

stages.title: Architecture and task slices
stages.prompt: Produce implementation-ready architecture and independently challenge it. Define boundaries, data/control flow, interfaces/contracts, ownership, dependencies, migration order, observability, test strategy, and bite-sized task slices with files/symbols and acceptance evidence. Do not implement.

stages.title: Completeness gate
stages.prompt: Audit the specification for requirement-to-design-to-task-to-test traceability, internal contradictions, missing failure paths, unsafe assumptions, unclear terminology, scope creep, and unresolved decisions. Return blocking gaps with exact remediation; pass only when another engineer can implement without rediscovery.

stages.title: Specification handoff
stages.prompt: Assemble the final specification handoff from the validated artifacts. Preserve provenance and confidence, distinguish verified facts from inference, list implementation slices and verification commands, and state explicitly that no application or specification files were changed by this workflow.
